applicability_model: FROZEN_APPLICABLE + POLICY_CONDITION_EVIDENCE -> EFFECTIVE_APPLICABILITY; one organization-level authoritative evaluation with repository projections only.
PASS_readiness: READY when injected or integrated qualifying authoritative organizational evidence satisfies the evidence contract.
FAIL_readiness: READY when injected or integrated qualifying authoritative organizational evidence proves an approved noncompliant condition.
HUMAN_REVIEW_readiness: READY: unavailable, inaccessible, incomplete, conflicting, stale, or insufficient authority routes to HUMAN_REVIEW.
exception_readiness: READY: validates Security Authority approval, compensating controls, owner, timestamp, renewal, closure, and review/expiration no later than 90 calendar days.
retention_boundary: Three-year remediation history retention is authoritative organizational-evidence scope and cannot be proven from current repository evidence alone.

exact_policy.classification: Use the severity rating issued by an approved vulnerability scanner as the remediation class.
exact_policy.targets: Critical: 7 calendar days; High: 30 calendar days; Medium: 90 calendar days; Low: 180 calendar days or documented risk-managed disposition.
exact_policy.clock_start: Start aging at the first validated detection timestamp recorded by the authoritative vulnerability evidence system.
exact_policy.clock_stop: Stop the remediation clock only upon verified remediation, approved false-positive closure, or an active approved risk acceptance or compensating-control exception.
exact_policy.evidence_authority: Use an approved vulnerability-management platform as the authoritative system of record, with a controlled integration to an approved security ticketing workflow where remediation work is tracked.
exact_policy.freshness: Evidence is current when the authoritative system was refreshed within the preceding 24 hours for open Critical or High findings and within the preceding 7 calendar days for other findings.
exact_policy.pass: PASS only when authoritative current evidence shows every applicable finding is within its remediation target or has a valid active approved closure, false-positive, or exception disposition.
exact_policy.fail: FAIL when current authoritative evidence proves an applicable finding is overdue without an active approved exception, lacks a required owner or target date, or has an expired exception.
exact_policy.human_review: Route to HUMAN_REVIEW when authoritative evidence is unavailable, inaccessible, incomplete, conflicting, stale, or insufficient to calculate a target or verify an exception.
exact_policy.exception: Require Security Authority approval, business justification, compensating controls, accountable owner, approval timestamp, expiration/review date no later than 90 calendar days, renewal before expiry, and closure evidence; expired exceptions are noncompliant.
exact_policy.applicability: Preserve FROZEN_APPLICABLE rows; evaluate EMS-CTRL-023 once per organization from authoritative organizational evidence, and expose repository rows only as projections with no repository-only PASS.
exact_policy.retention: Retain remediation finding, status, closure, and exception history in the authoritative evidence system for three years after closure or expiration.

negative_invariants: absent, inaccessible, stale, ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting organizational evidence never produces PASS
Critical/High evidence older than 24 hours never produces PASS
other evidence older than 7 calendar days never produces PASS
overdue finding without valid disposition FAILS when authoritative evidence is sufficient
expired exception FAILS when authoritative evidence is sufficient
repository projection cannot override organizational authority
Hayes cannot rewrite historical FROZEN_APPLICABLE records
three-year retention cannot be proven solely by current repository evidence
